method: All six final PNG images opened and visually inspected; overlays use actual native sections and unchanged source pixels.

views.observations: Opposed bearing orientations and separate cup/cone/cage/roller, spacer/shims, housing, packing/gland and coupling are visible. The near nut/cotter section shows unspread cotter legs. No obvious floating interior pieces in this cutaway.
Section exposes cup and inner race, two cut rollers and perforated cage. Printed radial/axial envelopes control the shape; rib forms and16-roller internals remain inferred.
Populated input assembly joins existing bevel case and transverse shaft. Cut surfaces conceal some tooth detail; this image is not the gear-mesh validation evidence.
Housing/gland are intentionally hidden with all placements retained. Gland bolts consequently appear suspended; cups obscure most rollers, so the section images are the interior evidence.

Conditional cup-OD registration places coupling flange near source end and matches overall bearing/spacer arrangement. Cone/cup widths, shoulder steps and cast profiles differ; modeled pinion radial profile remains narrower than illustration. Exact axial width residuals are retained in calibration.

Original hub-based scale retained. Inboard/outboard bearing spacing differs from Plate23 calibration. Coupling is drawn separately in source, so assembled extension outside principal source section is expected and not proof of excess shaft length.

disposition: Accept nominal visual reconstruction with explicit profile/scale/quantity uncertainty; not historical-fit or complete-transmission qualification.
required_followup: Complete housing mounting/pump/lubrication, brake-bearing joint and controls.
Retain source-registration and pinion-profile differences during future geometry refinement.
